_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parameters" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_muscle_group" TEXT NOT NULL, "secondary_muscle_groups" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_folders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "infobox" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "distance_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "folder_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routine_folders (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history_workouts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "infobox" TEXT NULL, "duration" INTEGER NOT NULL, "starting_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routines (id), "completed_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES history_workouts (id), "completes" TEXT NULL REFERENCES history_workouts (id), "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "distance_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "user_id"), UNIQUE ("completed_by", "completes"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history_workout_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES history_workouts (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parameters" TEXT NULL, "sets" TEXT NULL, "primary_muscle_group" TEXT NULL, "secondary_muscle_groups" TEXT NULL, "rest_time" INTEGER NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "library_exercise_id" TEXT NULL, "custom_exercise_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES custom_exercises (id), "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_superset" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_superset" IN (0, 1)), "is_in_superset" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_in_superset" IN (0, 1)), "superset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES history_workout_exercises (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES history_workout_exercises (id), "rpe" INTEGER NULL, "equipment" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "user_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parameters" TEXT NULL, "sets" TEXT NULL, "primary_muscle_group" TEXT NULL, "secondary_muscle_groups" TEXT NULL, "rest_time" INTEGER NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "library_exercise_id" TEXT NULL, "custom_exercise_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES custom_exercises (id), "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_superset" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_superset" IN (0, 1)), "is_in_superset" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_in_superset" IN (0, 1)), "superset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routine_exercises (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routine_exercises (id), "rpe" INTEGER NULL, "equipment" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "user_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "user_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preferences" ("data" TEXT NOT NULL, "onboarding_complete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("onboarding_complete" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ongoing_data" ("data" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "weight" REAL NOT NULL, "time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "value" REAL NOT NULL, "time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "date_added" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "json_data" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "reference_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "calories" REAL NOT NULL, "fat" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs" REAL NOT NULL, "protein" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_barcode_foods" ("barcode" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "json_data" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("barcode", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorite_foods" ("food_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id), "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_categories" ("id" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "reference_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "json_data" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "achievements_v2" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (("achievement_id" || '_') || CAST("level" AS TEXT)) STORED, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "achievement_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("achievement_id", "level", "user_id"));
